title: Volcano Engine Launches Doubao Real-Time Audio and Video Call Model SeedRealtime 1.0 API

content_html:
Real-time multimodal interaction is moving toward a more natural and fluid experience. Volcano Engine has recently officially launched the API service for its Doubao real-time audio-video call model, SeedRealtime1.0, providing developers and related applications with a new real-time audio-video interaction capability.

End-to-End Unified Modeling: Breaking the Bottleneck of Traditional Cascaded Pipelines

In past speech and multimodal interaction architectures, systems often had to connect multiple modules in series, such as automatic speech recognition (ASR), vision-language models (VLM), and text-to-speech (TTS). This cascaded processing approach not only tends to introduce extra response latency, but may also cause loss of information and emotional details as they are passed between modules.

SeedRealtime1.0 takes a different approach by unifying sound, visuals, timing, and expression into a single end-to-end model. With this architecture, the model can achieve real-time multimodal interaction that “watches, listens, and speaks at the same time,” reducing cascading latency while also effectively minimizing information loss across stages.

Application Value: Empowering More Natural Real-Time Audio-Video Scenarios

Through its open API service, Volcano Engine is exporting this end-to-end real-time audio-video capability to the broader ecosystem. Whether for intelligent assistants, real-time companionship, or various interaction scenarios that require synchronized perception of visual scenes and voice input, this model can help further improve the naturalness and coherence of responses.
